verdicts.reason: Both use the same crop, which cuts the cake/cream base and keeps only figs, so the dessert imagery is weaker than the original. A keeps the wreath lockup large and dominant like the original, but the 'aste' of 'Taste' and the lower wreath sit over the busy fig slices. B's lockup is shrunk to about a quarter of the width and floats small and timid over the cloth. That is cleaner behind the text but gives up headline hierarchy, so it reads like a shrunk copy, and the right side is still crowded.
